note: Index of every CLI in this checkout. Hosts, IPs and credentials never live here - the repo is public. `hub doctor` verifies what is actually installed; this file only says what SHOULD be.

clis.name: sapb1
clis.system: SAP Business One (3 companies: Oil, Mart, Beverages)
clis.answers: ledger balances, party statements, turnover and sales, A/R and A/P invoices, credit notes, sales and purchase orders, incoming and outgoing payments, stock items, document drafts
clis.write_note: The ONLY writable system. draft / post / patch / delete draft / add-draft. Every write previews, confirms and logs. See CLAUDE.md RULE 0.

clis.name: hana-sql
clis.system: SAP HANA (the SAP B1 core database, direct SQL)
clis.answers: anything SAP that is too big or too joined for the Service Layer - journal lines (JDT1), ageing, cross-company sweeps, cost centres and dimensions, bulk profiling
clis.write_note: Read-only by absence - no write path exists.

clis.name: postsql
clis.system: Postgres (16 application databases behind the JIVO web apps)
clis.answers: raw reads under ecom / factory / oms / exim - the tables the app CLIs only expose through endpoints

clis.name: jivo
clis.system: Control Panel (the sales lens over SAP)
clis.answers: realise (Rs/L), OIH, sales targets vs actual, inventory and production feasibility, required credit limit, ageing with remarks, masterdata
clis.write_note: Read-only. RULE 0 authorises writes to SAP only - Control Panel write endpoints exist but are NOT built and need the owner's sign-off.
clis.caution: The sales lens is NOT the accounts lens. realise = Rs/L not turnover; intercompany is INCLUDED; DONE/OIH are gross volume. Read the decoder before answering a sales question.

clis.name: gst-portal
clis.answers: filing status, returns, e-invoice enablement, branch address and PIN code from the registration profile (which SAP's OBPL does not carry)
clis.write_note: Read-only, enforced by a guard in the client.

clis.name: dsr
clis.answers: field sales activity, beat plans, targets and schemes, distributor coverage
clis.write_note: Read-only guard exists but is bypassable - DSR is deliberately kept off the MCP gateway.

clis.name: jmail
clis.answers: read a mailbox, find an approval thread, and print a thread to PDF for attaching to a SAP document
clis.write_note: Reads mail and writes PDFs to disk. Sends nothing.
clis.caution: `jmail print <uid>` is how an approval mail becomes the PDF that goes ON a payment draft (C-0028).

clis.name: jsap-cli
clis.answers: budget approvals, who approved what, pending approval queues, department and HOD structure
clis.caution: bud.jsBudgetTable DocEntry is a SAP DRAFT (ODRF), not OPCH - joining it to OPCH gives garbage.

clis.name: exim
clis.answers: import shipments, purchase orders against imports, landed cost, customs documents
clis.caution: Its tokens expire every 24h - a `gateway_status up:true` can sit in front of a 401 for days.

clis.name: factory-cli
clis.answers: production plans and releases, line management and OEE, GRPO feed, marketplace settings
clis.caution: GET /marketplace/settings/ CREATES rows. marketplace is Mart-only; production-release-oil is Oil-only.

clis.name: ecom-cli
clis.answers: channel sales, platform distributors, listings, stock sync
clis.caution: ecom /api/sap/* is JIVO_MART only - never Oil, never group (C-0008).

clis.name: oms-cli
clis.answers: sales orders and quotations raised through OMS, order status
clis.caution: OMS raises orders into Oil and Beverages ONLY - Mart order count from OMS is always zero (C-0011). /api/hana/* needs branch=OIL|BEVERAGE (C-0010).

clis.name: acc
clis.answers: scan the A/P backlog and send drafts in a batch instead of one bill at a time
clis.write_note: Writes through sapb1, so RULE 0 applies. `acc batch scan` is read-only; `acc batch send` creates drafts.

clis.name: jivo-scrape
clis.answers: competitor and marketplace listing history, price observations over time
clis.write_note: Reads its own archive. Touches no JIVO business system.
